title: TransArmor VeriFone Edition: Responses to Administrative Commands
applicability: Separate TransArmor administrative-response family; not a complete standard Segment 100 financial request/response layout in this ATL105 release.

businessRequirements.title: TransArmor administrative command responses shall be validated using the dedicated TransArmor specification rather than the standard Segment 100 financial response rules.
When a TransArmor administrative operation affects a Segment 100 tokenized transaction, its response and token state shall remain correlated with the originating transaction context.

testCases.positive: Administrative response validated against dedicated TransArmor contract
negative: Administrative response incorrectly accepted by standard Segment 100 validator

testCases.positive: Token state and originating transaction remain correlated
negative: Token response detached from originating transaction
